# Klicseo

> Doorstep car wash, car detailing, and one-time wash service in Chennai, India. Focus areas: Ullagaram, Puzhuthivakkam, Nanganallur, Adambakkam, Maduvinkarai.

Klicseo brings premium car care to the customer's doorstep — recurring subscription plans (weekly / monthly), one-time manual or machine washes, ceramic sealant coating, paint decontamination, interior detailing, and add-on services. Customers book online by selecting vehicle type, package, and callback time; serviceability is verified against the chosen address.

## Services
- Doorstep car wash (monthly subscription)
- Doorstep car wash (weekly plan)
- One-time manual wash
- One-time machine wash
- Ceramic sealant coating
- Interior detailing & add-ons
- Paint decontamination / clay bar treatment

## Service Areas (Chennai)
- Ullagaram
- Puzhuthivakkam
- Nanganallur
- Adambakkam
- Maduvinkarai

- [Home](https://klicseo.com/): Services overview, pricing, testimonials.

## Brand
Klicseo is a premium doorstep car care brand. Service is positioned around convenience (the team comes to the customer's home or office), consistency (recurring plans, trained crew), and quality (ceramic sealants, careful detailing — not commodity wash). Typical customers: car owners in South Chennai who value time and finish over cost.
